prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Preparing Your Pet for Your Desktop", "Your pet will automatically render on your main desktop screen once processing completes."]
1: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Use these quick desktop controls to interact with, move, or hide your pet anytime.", "Right-click pet for main menu. Double-click to talk or summon."]
2: ["Choose Your Pet Creation Path", "Whether you choose a starter companion or upload photos for a custom pet, your choices sync securely to your account.", "All pets are permanently attached to your profile across desktop reinstalls."]
3: ["For best 3D pet generation results, upload bright photos with clear front-facing lighting."]
4: ["Inspect Setup Status", "Companion Asset Status", "Your companion's 3D textures and desktop behaviors are currently assembling in the background.", "Return to Setup"]
5: ["What Your Desktop Companion Can Do", "Your pet rests on your desktop taskbar, reacts to mouse clicks, and keeps you company while you work.", "Choose My Companion Path"]
6: ["Sign In to Restore Your Pets", "Log into your account to sync your saved pets, custom avatars, and desktop progress automatically.", "Signing in ensures your desktop pet remains linked to your profile."]
7: ["Pick Your Companion Personality", "Select a starter pet style that fits your desktop workspace and daily habits."]
8: ["Enable notifications to receive desktop prompts when your pet wants to chat or play."]
9: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Create a unique AI companion or adopt a ready-made friend to live on your computer desktop.", "Begin Setup"]
